name: Hydroponics Equipment
description: Hydroponics are used to grow foodcrops in low-gravity and indoor environments.\n\nHydroponics are needed at Chernevog Station (Aragoth Prime, Aragoth System), and Praetorium Mons (Planet Primus, Vega System).

name: Frozen Meat
description: Cryogenically prepared and stored cuts of animal flesh, sufficently mixed with soy by-product to form round patties.\n\nFrozen Meat is needed at Fenris Observatory, Porvenir Mons, Friendship-7, Orsini Mining Platform, and Prasad Station.

name: Air Scrubbers
description: Special Equipment is required to remove carbon dioxide and toxic fumes and recirculate air in the confines of space and hostile planet environments.\n\nAir Scrubbers are needed at Loki Station and Arx Spartoi.

name: Fruit
description: Juicy bits of sweet goodness that supply vitamin C and other important nutrients to the body. Packaged under nitrogen for freshness during extended transport.\n\nFruit is in demand at Porvenir Mons, Prasad Station, and Yasuragi City.

name: Communications Arrays
description: Net boy, Net girl, send your impulse around the world, put your message, in a modem, and set it free, on a cyber-sea.\n\nComs Arrays are needed at Fenris Observatory.

name: Sol Citrus Fruit
description: The most delicious and prized fruits in the galaxy are still grown in the orchards of Earth from ancient stocks, shipped fresh, and never frozen or genetically enhanced.\n\nSol Citrus Fruit is needed at EarthCorps Command (Zweihander, Alpha Centauri).

name: Sol Grain
description: Whole grains are still essential for proper nutrition. The highest quality grains are still grown on Earth on the plains of Kansas and Russia.\n\nSol Grain is in high demand at Porvenir Mons (Planet Endriago, Gallina System).

name: Alpha Centauri Fruit
description: Juicy bits of sweet goodness that supply vitamin C and other important nutrients to the body. These are grown all over Alpha Centauri then packaged at EarthCorps Command, marked up, and shipped out under nitrogen.\n\nEarth Station trades in many fruit varieties.

name: Zweihander Fruits
description: Juicy bits of sweet goodness that supply vitamin C and other important nutrients to the body. These new genetically engineered varieties are grown in orchards on Zwiehander, and shipped fresh.\n\nEarthCorps Command mandates the inspection and sale of all outbound shipments; however, rumors exist of smuggling as far away as Trader's Fort.

name: Beta Hydri Fruit
description: Juicy bits of sweet goodness that supply vitamin C and other important nutrients to the body. These are grown in special solar greenhouses in Glory's Orbit, and shipped in nitrogen-filled cryocontainers for extended transport.\n\nBeta Hydri Fruit is in demand at Earth Station (Earth, Sol System) and Somerled Station (New Edinburg, Tau Ceti System).

name: Tau Ceti Fruit
description: Tau Ceti Fruits are developed by Infiniticorp scientists and grown in the lush gardens and orchards of Somerled Station. For unknown reasons, they never spoil, making shipping easy and cheap.\n\nEarth Station (Earth, Sol System) trades in fruit varieties.

name: GenoColor
description: One of the rare exported products of Progen genetic engineering. Vain aristocrats pay well for the ability to color their body parts at whim.\n\nGenoColor is in demand at Somerled Station (New Edinburg, Tau Ceti System), and Loki Station (High Earth, Sol System, Traders Only!)

name: Nanobots
description: Microscopic robots mere nanometers in size that can be programmed for any task from reconstructing biological tissues, to terraforming a planet. Produced only in secret Jenquai laboratories in Fenris Observatory.\n\nNanobots are always in high demand at Somerled Station (New Edinburg, Tau Ceti System).

name: Jenquai Technology
description: Bits of Jenquai technology are occasionally bartered off by the more unscrupulous Sharim and smuggled out to eager buyers.\n\nArx Spartoi, Chernovog Station, and Friendship-7 often have "eager buyers".

name: First Aid Kits
description: Always vital to save a life, stat!, re-attach a pinky toe, or just to treat cuts and scrapes.\n\nFirst Aid Kits are always needed at Chernovog Station.

name: Medical Equipment
description: Everything used by doctors, nurses, and apothecaries galaxy-wide.  Gauze pads, ECG machines, scalpels...\n\nMedical Equipment is needed on Chernovog Station (Aragoth Prime, Aragoth System)

name: Spacebite Cures
description: Space Herpes... how disgusting!  Cures bites quickly and mostly painlessly, avoiding the unpleasant aftermath.\n\nFor some strange reason, Chernovog Station (Aragoth Prime, Aragoth System), and Loki Station (High Earth, Sol System, Traders only!) have had a high demand for these recently.

name: Stem Cells
description: Illegal in Terran and Jenquai systems, but valued in Progen space, these are the pluripotent units of life.\n\nHigh in demand at Chernovog Station (Aragoth Prime, Aragoth System).

name: Progen Weapons Technology
description: The makers and users of the most powerful weapons known to humankind - Progen.  Eager buyers await.  Legitimacy is not guaranteed.\n\nTrader's Fort (Ragnarok, Aragoth System) has a good demand for Progen Weapons Technology.

name: Cleaning Bots
description: Dust and dirt just seem to collect everywhere, even in space. Why not have a bot clean it up for you?\n\nCleaning Bots are needed at Aragoth Station (Valkyrie Twins, Aragoth System), Arx Ymir (Jotunheim, Aragoth System), Earth Station, and Net-7 (Saturn, Sol System).

name: PermaHair
description: Want to grow hair... anywhere?  Tired of being called cue-ball or chromedome?  Undo the thinning on top with this rare export of Progen gene technology.\n\nPermaHair is in high demand on Somerled Station (New Edinburg, Tau Ceti System), and Earth Station (Earth, Sol System)

name: Repair Robots
description: Repair Robots can go where humans can't and repair almost anything except a broken heart.\n\nThey are needed at Aragoth Station (Valkyrie Twins, Aragoth System), Arx Ymir (Jotunheim, Aragoth System).

name: Terran Rank Insignia
description: Terrans go through a lot of soldiers, and thus a lot of rank insignia.\n\nAll are sold to EarthCorps Command (Zweihander, Alpha Centauri System).

name: Frozen Animal Zygotes
description: Little buggers cute and not so much, all cryogenically stored and waiting to be raised and consumed.\n\nZygotes are needed at Kinshasa-Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni A System).

name: Insects & Arthropods
description: Turns out the lifeforms humans generally hate most are essential for planet seeding and terraforming.\n\nInsects are needed on Kinshasa-Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni A System).

name: Live Animals
description: Cows, pigs, platypuses, you name it - animals are given some padding, some oxygen, and boxed up for shipping.\n\nLive Animals are needed in Kinshasa-Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni A System).

name: Seeds
description: Plants make seeds.  Seeds grow plants.  Plants make more seeds.  Seeds grow more plants...  A useful mix of monocots and dicots to feed humans and animals alike.\n\nSeeds are needed in Kinshasa-Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni A System).

name: Soil
description: Large bags of silicon, quartz, humus, moss, pearlite, clay, mica, lime, calcium carbonate, with nutrients and trace elements.  Essential for terraforming and agriculture.\n\nSoil is needed in Kinshasa-Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni A System).

name: Anti-Rads
description: These devices are packed with carbon, lead, and other dense, neutron-absorbent materials.\n\nAnti-Rads are needed on Loki Station (High Earth, Sol System, Terran Traders only!), where they've been having some radiation problems.

name: O2 Canisters
description: Ah oxygen, the diatomic molecule that's the stuff of life.  Fill your pink fleshy lungs with it every chance you get.\n\nO2 Canisters are in demand at Loki Station (High Earth, Sol System, Terran Traders only!)

name: Bread
description: "Man cannot live by bread alone..." but it is still a versatile and tasty food.\n\nBread is needed at Mercury Station (Glory's Orbit, Beta Hydri System).

name: Cotton
description: "The touch, of cotton... the fabric of our lives" - Aaron Neville.  Fluffy white cuddly strands used by plants for seed dispersal, and by humans for textile production.\n\nCotton is needed on Mercury Station (Glory's Orbit, Beta Hydri System).

name: Candy
description: Sweet, tangy, sour, sugary, hard, soft, crunchy, gooey, and all guaranteed to rot your tooth enamel.  Calms the nerves and eases pregnancy.\n\nCandy is needed on Mercury Station (Glory's Orbit, Beta Hydri System).

description: We thank you for all you've done to support this project. Enjoy the rest of the stress test and have a merry X-mas! - the FortyTwoAndBeyondEMU Dev Team

name: Animal Feed
description: Wholesome, balanced pet food. This food is said to help improve your pet's life span and keep them healthy.\n\nThis is needed in 61 Cygni, on Kinshasa-Mbali.

name: Aragoth News Updates
description: News local to the Aragoth System. It is published by a branch of Net-7 News.\n\nThe team at Net-7 Station will be looking forward to recieveing these updates so the news can be redistributed accurately, fairly and honestly.

name: Art
description: Beautiful pictures that can be hung anywhere to create a more aesthetically pleasing environment.\n\nIt takes an esthetic eye for this sort of item. It is widely known that the effete can be found on Somerled.

name: Atmospheric Stabilizer
description: An item used in terraforming harsh planets into habitable areas. Atmospheric stabilizer aids in removing excess amounts of carbon dioxide and nitrogen from the atmosphere of planets.\n\nThe Mines of 61 Cygni are in constant need of these precious items as the mine air grows quickly stale without them.

name: Bacteria
description: Harmless bacteria used in testing medicines.\n\nMedicines are synthesized on Kinshasa-Mbali.

name: Beta Hydri News Updates
description: News local to the Beta Hydri System. It is published by a branch of Net-7 News.\n\nThe team at Net-7 Station will be looking forward to recieveing these updates so the news can be redistributed accurately, fairly and honestly.

name: Biotoxins
description: Toxic substances excreted by creatures. They are often used to make antivenom or used in medical laboratories.\n\nAragoth Station and Tokai Saikutsu can refine and synthesize this material.

name: Clothing
description: Garments manufactured in Tau Ceti. 80% grek hide, 20% polyester.\n\nInverness Down has the creme-de-la-creme of clothing stores.

name: Coffee
description: Ungrounded coffee beans grown from coffee plants on planet Earth.  Because of its caffeinated qualities, it is a popular drink around the universe.

name: Comic Books
description: Books of comics read for entertainment. Common topics include superheros, ninjas, samurai, and pirates. CAUTION: may include zombies!\n\nThere is a huge market for these on Mercury Station. They must have the largest base of fanboys in the galaxy!

name: Construction Equipment
description: Various equipment used in construction. Space-safe and durable for all your construction needs.\n\nDistributed to the remote areas from 61 Cygni.

name: Cosmetics
description: Hair care products, makeup, perfume and other products that enhance beauty, make skin softer, and care for the body.\n\nBeauty spas and salons on Somerled host some of the most vain, shallow, benal and trite consumers of these goods in the whole Galaxy!

name: Data Cubes
description: An alternate form of memory management. Data cubes are more capable of holding data than discs but are not able to be easily overwritten.\n\nNews that spans an entire Galaxy needs tons of storage space. Net-7 Sol is in constant need of these.

name: Drive Waste
description: A by-product of nuclear reactors used to power stations in desolate areas.\n\nThis particular item is shipped out from Tokai Saikutsu and Inverness Downs.

name: Envirosuits
description: Spacesuits used for space walking. Designed to deal with the cold, inhospitable environment of space. \n\nTraders Fort makes certain they are always stocked up on these for distribution throughout Aragoth.

name: Feelies
description: Holographic novels that are sensory enhanced for the user's enjoyment..\n\nMost popular with the lads on Orsini Mining Platform.

name: Fertilizer
description: Fertilizer made from kraken cow manure. It is spread on plants to give them extra nutrients, allowing them to grow faster, larger, and with greater quality.\n\nThis is in demand on Kinshasa-Mbali.

name: Fertilized Eggs
description: Fertilized chicken eggs from Earth. Fertilized eggs are needed on planets hospitable for chickens.

name: Friendship Tourists
description: Tourists from Friendship-7 who want to tour Beta Hydri. \n\nIt would be profitable to bring Friendship Tourists to Friendship 7 in Beta Hydri.

name: Frozen Beef
description: A long time Progen favorite, delicious beef frozen to preserve taste with no preservatives.\n\nFrozen Beef is in demand at Porvenir Mons (Planet Endriago, Gallina System)

name: Fungus Spores
description: Small spores to breed a species of fungi that is good at breaking down rock for minerals.\n\nIn demand at Kinshasa Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni System).

name: Gas Canisters
description: Canisters full of natural gas. It can be used as an energy source but it also helpful in manufacturing processes.\n\nGas Canisters are needed at Somerled Station (New Edinburgh, Tau Ceti System).

name: Glenn Planet Artwork
description: Artwork from local artists of Glenn Planet. Glenn Planet is a sparsely populated planet but it is renowned for its significant contributions to the styles of artwork and music.\n\nGlenn Planet Artwork is in demand at Mercury Station (Glory's Orbit, Beta Hydri).

name: History Novels
description: Novels written based on historical events. They were once a relatively unknown genre, but have gained popularity after the end of the Gate War.\n\nHistory Novels are wanted at Paren Station (Kailaasa, Capella System).

name: Holomagazines
description: Take luxury to a whole new height with holomagazines! Turn the pages and watch the pictures pop out right at you. The pictures can change or move while you are looking at them.\n\nThis luxury is in demand at Orsini Mining Platform (Carpenter, Beta Hydri).

name: Holomusic
description: Load holomusic into your Tri-D Projector and watch your favorite bands come alive. The bands will appear to be right in front of you as if you were at a live concert.\n\nHolomusic is in demand at Orsini Mining Platform (Carpenter, Beta Hydri System).

name: Jenquai Weapons Technology
description: Jenquai weapons are some of the most energy efficient in the universe. It's no wonder people seek the technology to make their own weapons better. The Jenquai are also brilliant beam makers.\n\nWanted at Somerled Station (New Edinburgh, Tau Ceti System).

name: John Webster Plays
description: Classic literature from Earth that has been popular for more than 750 years.\n\nThe plays are in demand at Arx Spartoi (Endriago, Gallina System).

name: Koster's Lager
description: A newer Lager popularized at Arx Magister. It is now a Progen favorite.

name: Live Animals- Chickens
description: Mostly natural live chickens. These chickens were raised on the plains of Earth Planet. Useful as a food source: They lay eggs for most of their lives and when they stop you can eat them.\n\nLive chickens are in demand at Kinshasa Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni System).

name: Live Animals- Cows
description: Bovine beef. Beloved animals on farms. They are loved mostly for their wholesome milk they produce.\n\nCows are in demand at Kinshasa Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni System).

name: Live Animals- Goats
description: A species of animal from Earth. Its milk is used for food and its hair is used to make clothes.\n\nGoats are in demand at Kinshasa Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni System).

name: Live Animals- Llamas
description: A lovable species from Earth. It is desired for its fur and can also used as a way of transporting people and goods. With the introduction of better transporation to Earth, llamas became less of a necessity and pet llamas became more popular.\n\nLlamas are in demand at Kinshasa Mbali (Aganju, 61 Cygni System).

name: Net-7 Daily News Updates
description: Daily news from Net-7 SOL! Keep up with current events through Net-7 News. Tomorrow's news today, Net-7 News!\n\nNet-7 Daily News Updates are in demand at Earth Station, Friendship 7, Trader's Fort, and Somerled Station.

name: Xenobiological Studies

description: Raw material mined from the rocks of Aganju. It is said to have properties that amplify Psi abilities but so far this has not been prooven. \n\nRumor has it that there is a buyer on Somerled station but what it is used for is still a mystery.

name: Mine Guards
description: Pods filled with eager young Guards ready to start work on a brand new plant. They come equiped, trained and ready for action.\n\nDue to the rising trouble on Aganju, Kinshasa Mbala is requesting more and more of these fellows.

name: Psi-Regulator Serum
description: Geneticaly refined polysacharides that regulate neural activity to the Pineal gland. Dampens psionic capability allowing Psi's to be managed easily.\n\nThis inhibitor has been constantly shipped to Kinshasa-Mbali since the Psi's have been tasked to work in the mines.

name: Psi-Units
description: A pod full of rather disgruntled Psi's, not very happy about having to work in the mines. They are normally considered dangerous but use of a special serum keeps their abilities in check. It might be a good idea to keep some on hand when transporting these units.\n\nKinshasa-Mbali is more than happy to accept any shipment of Psi's to help work in the mines.

name: Smallpox Vaccine
description: After the rampant plague that all but wiped out the residents of Zweihander, the traders take pains to keep a steady supply of vaccines available for public consumption.\n\nMerchants of Jagerstadt are constantly buying vaccine supplies as they find they can never keep a full stock.

name: Off-duty Troops
description: A pod full of eager young troops ready for a little R&R. It might be a good idea to alert the authorities to double up on guard patrols.\n\nJagerstadt economy relies on a number of sources but they are more than happy to have visiting Off-duty Troops to give it a boost now and then.

name: MacGregor's Lager
description: A crate of old MacGregor's engine brewed Lager. An aquired taste for the deep spacer.\n\nThis unique light brew is eagerly consumed on Earthcorp High Command (Zweihander, Alpha Centauri) and Jagerstadt (Planet Zweihander, Alpha Centauri).

name: Tau Ceti News Updates
description: News local to the Tau Ceti System. It is published by a branch of Net-7 News.\n\nThe team at Net-7 Station will be looking forward to receiving these updates so the news can be redistributed accurately, fairly and honestly.

name: Toys
description: There was a time when toys were simple wood representations of a vehicle or practically anything. Nowadays a child's toy can clean his room, do his homework or any other amazing feat that would make their life easier. Fragile! Handle with care.\n\nToys are distributed from Mercury Station.

name: Scinnies
description: Environmentaly contained crates containing Scaracens bound for the races.\n\nThey are bought on Mercury Station.

name: Tri-D Games
description:
Games of the modern age engage the player in all senses, immersing them into a virtually crafted environment yet buffering sensory stimulus so that no damage can occur.
Ain't technology grand?!

Mercury Station distributes these and the lads on Orsini Mining Platform spend most of thier off time playing games.

name: Null-G Art
description: Art crated in a zero gravity. It's new, it's hip, it's all the rage. It is also very dangerous.\n\nIt takes a practiced eye to appreciate this work. Those  that feel they have this gift flock to Somerled and Earth Station to buy them up.

name: Resource Crates
description: Refined materials of varying types packed and ready for shiping.\n\nAlthough these are used everywhere, the main centers for distribution are on Paren, Earth, Somerled, and Friendship 7 stations.

name: Refining Equipment
description: All the bits and pieces of equipment needed to set up or repair an industrial refining station. \n\nOrsini Mining Platform is in constant need of this material to continue supplying the galaxy with greatly needed building materials.

name: Mercury Tourist
description: Eager travellers bound for an exotic visit to Mercury Station.

name: Stardust
description: Recently, due to advances in science it has been discovered that solar flares emit a waste product that can be used in production. This is euphemisticaly called Stardust.\n\nStardust can be sold on Mercury Station.

name: Psionic Packs
description: Used to enhance any latent abilities, this item is typicaly consumed for recreation purposes.\n\nMercury Station asks for a steady supply.

name: Souvenirs
description: Souvenirs. Brickabrack. Knickknacks. All the little parephenalia that makes life bearable, knowing you have the complete collection of the newest crystal, porcelean or percious metal what-have-you. \n\nThese items are consumed in great quantity from Mercury station.

name: Silk
description: Silk, from some type of exotic worm used in the making of cloth and various textile goods.\n\nMercury Station has a high demand for this material.

name: Progen Rank Insignia
description: Medals showing Progen glory in Battle. \n\nNeeded at  Praetorium Mons

name: Genetic Material
description: Genetic goo used in cloning.  Needed Badly at  Praetorium Mons.

name: Progen Small Arms
description: Personal weapons designed for land based warfare.\n\nNeeded at Praetorium Mons.

name: hamradio
description: multi band transmiter recever

name: Pets
description: As tastes vary so do the popularity of the contents of these crates.  Whatever noise, or substance emmits from these boxes it is a good bet, opening them would be a bad idea.\n\nDeliver these to Somerled.

name: Pet Food
description: All the nutrients and vitamines mixed in a format your pet will appealing.\n\nThe markets on Somerled need a steady stock of this item.

name: War Novels
description: Of all things that fascinate mankind, War has always been at the forefront. If you can't engage in it, why not read about it. Yet, there are more calls against the horrors and indiscretions of war than any other state. Maybe they should be reading a study in psychology instead.\n\nPopular on Porvenir Mons and Arx Spartoi. No surprise there.

name: Pesticides
description: A mixture of bio-friendly chemicals that are used to retard voracious pests from eating tender growing crops.\n\nThe farmers on Aganju are fond of using this material.

name: Romance Novels
description:
Cheesey books of love stories mostly consumed by women to transport them on an adventourous journey, far away from the cares and woes of their banal and boring lives.
Lately, Progen of both sexes have been seen secretly purchasing these books in abundance.

There is a great demand for these books on Arx Spartoi and Povenir Mons.

name: Sol Drive Waste
description: For some reason waste from Terran reactors produces a unique concoction of chemicals than other types. This soup can be  tools refined for purposes that typical waste cannot.\n\nThe labs on Tokai Saikutsu can refine this material best.

name: Sol News Updates
description: News local to the Sol System. It is published by a branch of Net-7 News.\n\nThe team at Net-7 Station will be looking forward to recieveing these updates so the news can be redistributed accurately, fairly and honestly.

name: Vaccines
description: A spectrum of Immunity suppliments for just about every common malady known to humanity. Keep refrigerated!\n\nAlthough they are needed throughout the galaxy, the traders on Earth Station stock up on them to supply the various medical institutions throughout the cosmos.

name: Arbhaka Teeth
description: Small filter teeth taken from the young Arbhaka. Made of a very resillient calcium construction, they are used for many purposes including dart-like ammunition.

name: Shinwa Intelligence Sirius 1

Author mentions a strange incident in which her ship's shields were suddenly drained of power, and another where the range of her scanning computer was substantially reduced. In all cases, she reports a sense of being observed, even "toyed with" by a disant entity that she idenifies as "The Hidden One."

name: EarthCorps Military Report: "Pirates"
description: A long, detailed and psychologically sophisticated character sketch of Shou Tzu, purported leader of the Red Dragon pirate tongs. Surprising conclusion reached that his tactics in fighting and diplomacy show strong similarities to those taught by the Shinwa sect of the Jebquai. Includes some names of the Red Dragon pirates who are known to be former Shinwa.

name: InfinitiCorp ExecReport Cy864
description: Details the profits made by InfinitiCorp from the sale of Nommos Hunting Permits in the Aganju sector of 61 Cygni. In its first year, the experimental venture attracted numerous wealthy executives from as far away as Earth, resulting in significant corporate profit. Orkael Lazarra, who first proposed the Hunting Permit program, forsees considerable possibilities for such 'alternative eco-tourism' in Aganju sector and has recently begun selling Permits to anyone able to pay his fees.

name: First Inspiration
description: April 28, 2050 - We began our journey yesterday. Today has been a day of reflection, and I am wondering.. what will this journey become? <there is more>

name: Second Inspiration
description: June 2, 2050 -I have been on this ship for two months and the truth is sinking in. I will be on this ship for years. I might perish in space. We might fail and all our efforts would be worthless. But my goal drives me through these harsh realizations.. <there is more>

name: Third Inspiration
description: September 22, 2050 - Why am I doing this, I ask myself.. Why am I not back on Earth?... The answer.. Earth is a planet of routine. What is the purpose of living the same way as everyone else? It is in our nature to adventure and learn.. <there is more>

name: Sha'ha'dem Scientific Report Si2
description: A confusing, oftentimes contradictory account of three months of research beyond the Intzalan Line, near the primary star of Sirius. Describes some of the unexplained effects reported by ships in this area, including temporary loss of equipment functionality, temporary reductions in in engine speed, and sudden losses of reactor energy. Effects are almost always preceded by a prickling at the back of the neck, a feeling of dread, or a sense of being observed from afar.
